name: manual_e528e4
claim: Give every Windows PowerShell script that contains non-ASCII text a UTF-8 BOM, and parse every tracked .ps1 with the real 5.1 parser in a test.

decisions.notes: Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads BOM-less UTF-8 as ANSI; an em dash's third byte becomes a right double quote that ends the string early, so a script silently failed to parse for months. 2026-10-26 audit.

rationale: Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads BOM-less UTF-8 as ANSI; an em dash's third byte becomes a right double quote that ends the string early, so a script silently failed to parse for months. 2026-10-26 audit.
